# ADR-NNNN: Decision title

Date: YYYY-MM-DD
Supersedes: ADR-NNNN (only for an ADR that replaces earlier ones; otherwise delete this line)

## Context

The problem, the forces at play, and what's known, linking the issue or design doc it came from.

## Decision

What was decided, stated so it can be followed, and what still holds from any ADR it replaces.

## Alternatives considered

Each serious alternative, and why it wasn't chosen.

## Consequences
